fnol_text: My name is Samuel Oyelaran and I live at 410 Rowan Way, Salem, MA 01971. You can reach me on (555) 908-6492 or samuel.oyelaran@example.com. A delivery driver slipped on our icy front steps on 8 September 2025 and was taken to hospital. They have said they will make a claim against us. Policy HH-2025-00144. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. I assume this is covered under my policy?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Oyelaran on (555) 908-6492 to acknowledge the claim. Samuel confirmed the loss date as 8 September 2025.
Site visit to 410 Rowan Way. Neighbour Naomi Ballard was present and confirmed the timeline.
Injured party Imogen Petrov sustained a fractured left wrist and was treated at County General. Do not admit liability; refer.
